description: Verify that DHCPDISCOVER is retransmitted when no DHCPOFFER arrives (RFC 2131 §3.1 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
Lost DISCOVERs / OFFERs would deadlock the client without retransmission. RFC 2131 §3.1 mandates retransmission of the DISCOVER if no OFFER arrives within the timeout.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER #1.
2. Tester does NOT reply with OFFER.
3. After timeout: DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER #2   ← key check

[Pass condition]
A second DISCOVER appears within the retransmission window.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_first_discover — DUT did not emit even the first DISCOVER
• Fail_no_resend — first DISCOVER observed but no retransmission

verdicts.Fail_no_first_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
